svg.title: Flow figure: Voice recorder, Game stage, Speech handler, Turn handler, Story director, Rules & skills, Voice output, Bolna Voice AI, SQLite store, DeepSeek LLM, ElevenLabs TTS. Steps: 1. Speak & transcribe, 2. Direct & validate, 3. Voice & stage.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Voice recorder, Game stage, Speech handler, Turn handler, Story director, Rules & skills, Voice output, Bolna Voice AI, SQLite store, DeepSeek LLM, ElevenLabs TTS. 1. Speak & transcribe. The player holds Space to record a Japanese line. The stage uploads the audio blob to the speech handler. Bolna Voice AI transcribes the recording with Japanese biasing. The speech handler returns the transcript and pronunciation score. 2. Direct & validate. The stage submits the spoken turn to the turn handler. The turn handler builds the scene context for the story director. DeepSeek generates the coach verdict and Kenji's reply as JSON. The rules engine clamps rewards and levels up the Genki skill tree. The turn handler commits the run state and dialogue lines to SQLite. 3. Voice & stage. The turn handler returns the validated beats and skill unlock. The stage requests spoken audio for Kenji's dialogue line. ElevenLabs synthesizes Kenji's voice and caches the MP3 on disk. The stage plays Kenji's voice while animating the scene.

g.text: The player holds Space to record a Japanese line.
The stage uploads the audio blob to the speech handler.
Bolna Voice AI transcribes the recording with Japanese biasing.
The speech handler returns the transcript and pronunciation score.
The stage submits the spoken turn to the turn handler.
The turn handler builds the scene context for the story director.
DeepSeek generates the coach verdict and Kenji's reply as JSON.
The rules engine clamps rewards and levels up the Genki skill tree.
The turn handler commits the run state and dialogue lines to SQLite.
The turn handler returns the validated beats and skill unlock.
The stage requests spoken audio for Kenji's dialogue line.
ElevenLabs synthesizes Kenji's voice and caches the MP3 on disk.
The stage plays Kenji's voice while animating the scene.
